selection_algorithm: root Cargo.lock registry packages -> fresh cargo vendor --locked --versioned-dirs -> validate lock/package/file checksums and .cargo_vcs_info.json git sha/path_in_vcs -> normalize upstream URL -> lexicographically first package per URL -> require >=4 documented public Rust symbols -> sort (Rust SLOC,name,version) with deterministic name/version tie break -> first 24, next 24, last 24; require 72 unique upstream repositories after every filter
